biggest_catch: New Mexico-only: you must be an Xcel Energy New Mexico customer with a qualifying smart thermostat on central AC, and you're agreeing to let Xcel adjust your thermostat during peak demand events.
catches: Must be an Xcel Energy New Mexico residential customer.
Requires a qualifying smart thermostat connected to central air conditioning.
You agree to let Xcel make small thermostat adjustments during peak events.

c1.evidence: Xcel Energy is the regulated electric utility in New Mexico (Southwestern Public Service); program page is on nm.my.xcelenergy.com.

c2.evidence: Official Xcel Energy New Mexico Thermostat Rewards page states: $100 one-time enrollment bill credit plus $25 annually.

c4.evidence: Official page states the enrollment bill credit plus the annual reward while enrolled.

eligibility: Xcel Energy New Mexico residential customer with a qualifying smart thermostat on central AC. Enroll the thermostat in Thermostat Rewards.
notes: Verified from the official Xcel Energy New Mexico Thermostat Rewards page on 2026-09-23. State-specific route, distinct from South Dakota (R0797) and Colorado (R0798). Bill-credit rewards — framed as bill savings, not income.
payout_quote: $100 one-time enrollment bill credit plus $25 annually for participating in Thermostat Rewards.

s1.note: NM residential customer; qualifying smart thermostat on central AC.

s3.note: Enrollment credit on sign-up; $25 annually while enrolled.

s5.note: nm.my.xcelenergy.com — Xcel Energy's official New Mexico customer site.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: enroll thermostat, accept peak adjustments, credits post.

steps: Confirm you're an Xcel Energy New Mexico residential customer with central AC and a qualifying smart thermostat.
Enroll your thermostat in Thermostat Rewards on the Xcel Energy New Mexico page.
Allow small automatic adjustments during peak events (you can usually override them).
Receive your $100 one-time enrollment bill credit.
timing: Enrollment credit on sign-up; $25 annual credit while enrolled.
